## Invitations

A total of 1936 people were invited during the reporting period. Of these, 1374 attended, giving an attendance rate of 71.0 per cent. This indicates that most invitees took up the invitation. Attendance tends to dip in winter and recover in spring, and this seasonal pattern should be considered when reviewing results and planning future outreach activity. The figures provide a straightforward summary of participation among those invited and can support ongoing monitoring of engagement.

## Contact

SMS contact reached 0 invitees. Reminders were also sent to 0 people. No additional contact activity is recorded in the available information. The absence of recorded SMS and reminder activity should be noted when considering the attendance result, as these channels were not used to support participation during the period. Future outreach planning may wish to review the role of contact methods alongside seasonal patterns, while retaining the current invitation and attendance measures for comparison.
